headline: Bake workflow drops a run's data whenever its push is rejected (changed-file list is computed after the commit, so it is always empty), and the job still reports success; one-line fix on this branch. NY low 11-01 missed at p 0.94 (lock 44-45, settled 42 at 11:56 PM); NY high hit 11-02.

findings.title: Rejected push silently discards the run's bake
findings.evidence: kalshi-nyc.yml:146 computes changed after git commit -> empty; run 41461796405 (11-02 14:37Z) log 'changed: ' then 'origin already has this data', exit 0; sandbox replay: before remote kept old file, after this run's file landed

findings.title: CDN serves truncated trail, 48h+ (repeat, 3rd night)
findings.evidence: unbusted ny_high_2026-11-02 85 rows vs 259 (HIT age 79102); ny_high/ny_low 11-01 73/61 vs 300/288 (age 172704); fix 76828e2 on claude/kalshi-review-2026-11-02 still applies cleanly

findings.title: NY low binding lock overconfident
findings.evidence: kalshi_low_ny.json 11-01 lock 44-45 p 0.9385 sd 0.354, settled 42 (CLI final 42 at 11:56 PM, prelim 44 at 7:18 AM); all six models were under 44; binding locks with p>=0.85: 7/10 vs said 0.94

findings.title: Forecast outage hidden behind green runs
findings.evidence: 11-02 13:41-15:49Z: open-meteo 503/handshake timeouts, 'no forecast models available', ny_low FAILED; no trail rows for 2h; all runs concluded success
